the work of morphofunctional units in normal epithelium, fibroadenoma, or cancer of the breast is different.

the morphofunctional units of the breast epithelial tissue are the basic functional units in the breast tissue, which is a system of proliferative epidermal cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the number of proliferative cells in the epithelium of normal breast is twice as high as in a benign tumor and four times as high as in malignant tumor.
the number of morphofunctional units is reduced in cancer and fibroadenoma.
the morphofunctional organization of epithelial tissues is determined by the number of cells in morphofunctinal zones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphofunctional unit is the smallest functional structure in epithelial tissue and that its functional state is a reflection of the state of epithelium.
morphofunctional analysis of epithelial tissue is an effective method to diagnose breast cancer.
